scope: Isolated FA2 split backward: region/GQA/varlen correctness, not production integration or performance.
implementation_notes: Varlen uses per-sequence native launches; CUDA cu_seqlens are synchronized once at prepare.
Region selection launches intersecting 64-token KV tiles, discarding boundary surplus.
GQA retains compact input KV, with BF16 per-Q-head gradient scratch and ATen FP32 group sum cast to BF16.
Long shapes compared to fused FA only; FP64 reference tested on small shapes.
